description: Golden set for the Text-to-SQL step. Each case is a question and either a reference SQL query, whose result on data/railpulse_ai.db is the expected answer, or "expected": "NO_QUERY". The expected rows are never written here: they are computed from the database by running reference_sql, so a rebuild cannot leave a stale literal behind. in_few_shot marks questions that copy or closely paraphrase an example in TEXT_TO_SQL_SYSTEM_PROMPT; scores are reported with and without them. order_matters is true only where the question asks for a ranking or an order.

cases.question: How many stop events are in the dataset?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records

cases.question: What is the average delay in minutes across all stop events?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records

cases.question: What percentage of trains were on time overall?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "Delay Severity" = 'On Time (<2min)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records

cases.question: Which single station has the most stop events?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT "Stations Name" FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Stations Name" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What was the longest delay recorded, in minutes?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records

cases.question: How many stop events were classified as Severe?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Delay Severity" = 'Severe (>15min)'

cases.question: How many stop events are there in each delay severity category?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT "Delay Severity", COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Delay Severity"

cases.question: What is the average delay in minutes at Bruxelles-Central over the whole dataset?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Bruxelles-Central'

cases.question: What is the average delay in minutes for Anvers-Central today?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Anvers-Central' AND "Scheduled Date" = (SELECT MAX("Scheduled Date") FROM liveboard_records)

cases.question: Which day of the week has the highest average delay?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT day_of_week FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY AVG(delay_seconds) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many stop events were scheduled on 2026-08-05?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Scheduled Date" = '2026-08-05'

cases.question: What is the average delay in minutes for each hour of the day?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT "Hour", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Hour"

cases.question: Which 5 stations, among those with at least 100 stop events, have the highest average delay?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT "Stations Name" FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Stations Name" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY AVG(delay_seconds) DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many different stations appear in the stop events?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Stations Name") FROM liveboard_records

cases.question: How many distinct vehicle ids are there in the stop events?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_id) FROM liveboard_records

cases.question: What is the average delay in minutes on Saturdays and Sundays combined?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records WHERE day_of_week IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday')

cases.question: How many stop events had a delay of more than 30 minutes?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records WHERE delay_seconds > 1800

cases.question: Which train category (e.g. IC, S, L) has the most delays?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(r.train_category, 'Unknown') FROM liveboard_records lr LEFT JOIN trips t ON lr.vehicle_id = t.trip_id LEFT JOIN routes r ON t.route_id = r.route_id GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY AVG(lr.delay_seconds) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many stop events were made by IC trains?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records lr JOIN trips t ON lr.vehicle_id = t.trip_id JOIN routes r ON t.route_id = r.route_id WHERE r.train_category = 'IC'

cases.question: On which date was the average delay the highest?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT "Scheduled Date" FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Scheduled Date" ORDER BY AVG(delay_seconds) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What percentage of stop events at Bruxelles-Midi were on time?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "Delay Severity" = 'On Time (<2min)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Bruxelles-Midi'

cases.question: Compare the average delay in minutes between Bruxelles-Central and Bruxelles-Midi.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT "Stations Name", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" IN ('Bruxelles-Central', 'Bruxelles-Midi') GROUP BY "Stations Name"

cases.question: What hour of the day has the most delays?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT "Hour" FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Hour" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY AVG(delay_seconds) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many stop events were scheduled at Gand-Saint-Pierre in hours 7, 8 and 9?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Gand-Saint-Pierre' AND "Hour" BETWEEN 7 AND 9

cases.question: What was the average delay in minutes over the last 7 days of data?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Scheduled Date" >= (SELECT DATE(MAX("Scheduled Date"), '-6 days') FROM liveboard_records)

cases.question: List the 3 longest delays at Liège-Guillemins, in minutes.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT delay_seconds / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Liège-Guillemins' ORDER BY delay_seconds DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: How many stations have an average delay above 5 minutes, counting only stations with at least 100 stop events?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "Stations Name" FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Stations Name" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 AND AVG(delay_seconds) > 300)

cases.question: What are the first and last dates covered by the data?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MIN("Scheduled Date"), MAX("Scheduled Date") FROM liveboard_records

cases.question: How many stop events were canceled in the whole dataset?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records WHERE canceled = 1

cases.question: What percentage of stop events at Namur were Severe?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "Delay Severity" = 'Severe (>15min)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Namur'

cases.question: Which station, among those with at least 100 stop events, has the lowest average delay?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT "Stations Name" FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Stations Name" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY AVG(delay_seconds) ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Give the average delay in minutes for each date, in date order.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT "Scheduled Date", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Scheduled Date" ORDER BY "Scheduled Date"

cases.question: How many stop events were scheduled on Mondays?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records WHERE day_of_week = 'Monday'

cases.question: How many stop events had no delay at all?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveboard_records WHERE delay_seconds = 0

cases.question: What is the average delay in minutes for stop events in hours 17, 18 and 19?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Hour" BETWEEN 17 AND 19
